desc: Replace the incorrect NTT implementation with a correct standard forward/inverse NTT.
Build the indicator polynomial and perform exact convolution at a power-of-two length at least \(2\max(S)+1\).
Extract coefficients at \(2B\), remove the self-pair, divide by two, and sum.
Validate samples and edge cases including \(N<3\), consecutive values, sparse sets, and maximum-valued inputs.
Ensure memory and runtime are practical for \(N,\max(S)\le 10^6\).
